title: Alhambra Private Tour
text: It was a wonderful experience to have a guided tour of Alhambra. Our guide provided details that brought everything to life.
author: I3532HArichardt

title: Personal guide Alhambra tour with our family
text: Great enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide led us on a full tour of the Muslim gardens palaces and fortresses of the Alhambra. The site is beautiful, the gardens amazing and the history is fascinating. Highly recommended.
author: John_R

title: Wonderful tour of the Alhambra
text: Brilliant guide - real passion for history and great at communicating it. Particularly liked the translation of some of the writing on the walls of the Palaces, and the honest lack of explanation for something, when there is none - particularly why are there western paintings and sculptures of lions when Islam forbids such images? We enjoyed the discussion immensely, and the 10 minute break for coffee to pause and assimilate, and the gentle pace with which the tour progressed. An unforgettable morning in an unforgettable place.
author: Andrew_S

title: Visit to The Alhambra, Granada
text: We recently visited The Alhambra in Granada and were lucky to have booked a private walking tour with Dani. He made a very special experience  even better with his knowledge, friendliness and patience. He answered all of our questions and made us feel completely at ease and comfortable. We thoroughly enjoyed the day and would highly recommend this tour. Thankyou Dani!
author: B6631ARrenew

title: Great experience at a...
text: Great experience at a beautiful location with a very experienced guide, we learned a lot about the history of Alhambra, with some fun facts included. Thanks a lot for the great tour
author: Florine_R

title: A must do
text: The views were amazing fro the generalife. The palaces were breath taking. The knowledge we learned from our guide fully encompassed the history of such a beautiful place. A must do.
author: Francesco_C

title: Must see Alhambra!
text: Fascinating! The palace, grounds and gardens are a must see! The Alhambra is so worth the trip to Grenada! Beautiful! Historical! Amazing! We had a private tour and really enjoyed it!
author: Tracy_G

title: Top experience with guide in German
text: We booked a tour in German (received confirmation). This date was coordinated with our Granada stay. Unfortunately, we have received a cancellation for the desired (and confirmed) date. Only in English. After some back and forth we could book a private tour 2 days earlier with Rosa. After initial trouble we must say it was perfect. The tour from 4:45 p.m. in wonderful light and relatively few visitors was a special experience. Rosa took a lot of time and introduced us to the Alhambra and its history. She speaks perfect German. Every cent was worth it. Thank you again.
author: wado168

title: Perfect Alhambra-Tour
text: Our very friendly guide Rafael is the most competent guide, all historical informations, many anecdotes, really perfect.
author: Natalie_P

title: Knowledgeable & Great English
text: Our guide was very personable and demonstrated in depth knowledge of the site. We learnt a lot and enjoyed ourselves. It was worth paying for the private tour.
author: Jenny M
